title: Use Google Cloud Text To Speech
desc: Note: Requires a Google Cloud account and project set up, using the Text To Speech API service. See document Using Google Cloud Text To Speech with EDCoPilot.pdf in docs folder.    IMPORTANT REMINDER: You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account. EDCoPilot will warn you when monthly free quota thresholds are met, and you can disable this feature if you are going to exceed your free quota, or continue usage and be billed accordingly.

title: GTTS Language Code
desc: Select accent, then reselect voice name option below from available list

title: GTTS Voice Feature
desc: Select between Wavenet (RECOMMENDED), Neural2, Chirp-HD, Studio or  Standard voice feature (different free amounts and costs once free amounts exceeded)

title: GTTS Voice Name
desc: Select the voice to be used.

title: GTTS Pitch
desc: Change the pitch of your copilot voice (range: -20 to 20). Note, is not supported by Chirp-HD and Studio voices.

title: GTTS Rate
desc: Change the speed of your copilot voice (range: 0.8 to 4.0). Note, is not supported by Chirp-HD voices.

title: Reset GTTS character counts (CAUTION)
desc: ** WARNING ** Resets your counters of characters sent to Google Cloud. ONLY click this if you wish to set counters to 0 to reset usage count for next billing cycle
